safetyInvariants: READ → MEASURE → ANALYZE → EXPLAIN → RECOMMEND → PREVIEW → EXPLICIT APPROVAL → BACKUP → APPLY → VERIFY
no batch changes — one real-host transaction at a time
no launch==approval — viewing recommendation or launching Polaris is not approval
exact transaction approval — tied to transactionId + target + expected change + current file hash / unit hash / package state
beforeHash/unitHash validation — if changed after preview, approval invalidated, require new preview
backup before mutation — versioned ~/.local/state/polaris/backups/<tx>/ SHA-256 no overwrite, is_regular_file, fsync, if backup fails do not apply
rollback capability — every R2+ reversible operation declares rollbackPlan before execution
fail-closed state machine — StateMachine::isValidTransition rejects PROPOSED->APPLYING, throws logic_error, P12 added PREVIEWED/APPROVAL_REQUIRED/APPROVED → FAILED for stale

FileSafety protections — allowlist (/tmp/polaris-test-root + P5 pilot user file + /etc/fstab + ~/.local/state/polaris/profile.json + P14 IPC socket/lock allowlist), canonical, isSymlink, validatePath rejects .., ;|& `$ NUL >4096, symlink, non-allowlist, P12 TOCTOU + P13 profile + P14 socket/lock
no arbitrary shell — fixed executable paths (/usr/bin/systemctl, /usr/bin/dnf, execv separate args, no sh -c, no user input concat, bounded time/output)

no password collection — no sudo inside Polaris, no SUDO_ASKPASS, no password file, use narrowly scoped Polkit org.polaris.* auth_admin_keep, helper trust boundary Client (untrusted) | Helper (minimal, allowlist) | Polkit (OS)
no automatic reboot — rebootRequired explicit, P7 READY_FOR_REBOOT reported Reboot required, do not automatically reboot unless separately approved
no real-host mutation during discovery — ReadOnlyGuard kReadOnlyMode true openReadOnly only ifstream, test_readonly verifies stat /etc/fstab mtime unchanged

explicit approval for every real mutation — P5 TX-P5-... Hidden=true required approve with beforeHash, P6 TX-P6-...-MSSQL required approve, P7 NVIDIA-MIGRATION-CANDIDATE required explicit approval for R3, P12 binds approval to exact target/operation/hash/kernel/package, P13 profile is constraint not approval

P14 IPC security — Unix socket 0600 not world-writable, no symlink, SO_PEERCRED kernel creds not client-supplied, bounded request 64KB, no sh -c, no exec, no password, no traversal, allowlist ping/info only, no privileged mutation, TransactionLock flock exclusive, RecoveryDetector fail-closed (suggested FAILED)
P15 test/CI — table-driven deterministic isolated fixtures, no host mutation, TransactionValidator fail-closed for UNAVAILABLE, lock flock exclusive, recovery detection-only

P16 explainability — structured domain data, deterministic JSON, --verbose without secrets, WHY NOW evidence-backed, WHAT WILL CHANGE transaction-backed, WHAT WILL NOT CHANGE explicit, rejectionConditions deterministic, profile/comparison integration, never confuses approval with authorization
